claims.evidence: Witness only reports two black PlayStation consoles; exact model/version (PS4 vs PS4 Pro vs PS5) is not read from the photos.

Witness report shows controllers in front of the consoles in both photo views (at least one controller visible; second controller presence is not fully clear, but the report does not support 'only one pad' as a confirmed count).
No game list, console home screen, or storage/game library is shown in the witness observations.
No visible game titles or screenshots of the installed library are shown.

risks.risk: Console model/version is unclear (PS4 vs PS4 Pro vs other), which changes value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console model label (rear/bottom sticker) showing exact model number (e.g., CUH-xxxx) and/or a boot screen showing system version.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic/unknown PS4-generation console with higher uncertainty.

risks.risk: Working status is unknown (power on, HDMI output, disc drive reading, fan noise/overheating).
risks.proof: Video clip of powering on, showing the home screen, and (if disc drive exists) inserting a disc and confirming it reads; include HDMI display output.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly faulty (worst-case for buyers).

risks.risk: Storage size is unknown (affects how many games can be installed and overall value).
risks.proof: Photo of System Settings → Storage (or a screenshot showing total capacity).

risks.risk: Controller condition is unknown (stick drift, button responsiveness, charging port/battery health).
risks.proof: Video showing controller connected/paired, analog stick test (no drift), button presses responding, and charging test (charging indicator).
risks.if_unproven: Price as controller may need repair/replacement.

risks.risk: Cosmetic condition may hide deeper damage (scuffs/dust could indicate heavy use; possible missing parts not visible).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of ports (USB/HDMI), disc drive area, vents, and underside; include any missing screws/hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst visible cosmetic condition.

risks.risk: Accessories/cables are not confirmed (power/HDMI/controller charging cables missing reduces usability).
risks.proof: Photo of everything included laid out: power cable(s), HDMI cable, controller charging cable, and any headset/games.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming minimal essentials only (or missing cables).

risks.risk: Account status is unknown (linked accounts, bans, or reset status can affect usability).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the console showing it is signed out and/or a reset/initial setup screen (no personal account shown).
risks.if_unproven: Price as account status unknown and may require reset.

risks.risk: Seller may be overstating installed games/titles (common mismatch between claimed library and actual installed content).
risks.proof: Screenshot/photo of the installed games list (home screen/library) showing at least 10 titles and the specific FIFA/PES/GTA entries.
risks.if_unproven: Price without relying on the claimed game count/titles.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console model label (rear/bottom) for exact PS4 model number and storage capacity.
Video showing the console powering on to the home screen with HDMI output working.
If disc drive is present: video inserting a disc and confirming it reads.
Video or close photos of controller ports and a quick controller test (no stick drift; buttons respond).
Photo of the full accessories list (power cable(s), HDMI cable, controller charging cable) laid out.
Screenshot/photo of the installed games library showing the actual titles and count.
response.reason: The witness confirms PlayStation consoles and controllers are present, but key pricing drivers (exact model, working status, storage, and confirmed game library) are not shown clearly enough to price confidently without missing shots.
